strategy_config.restore: Resolve exact schema/artifact/config under accepted current context

research_run.restore: Resolve all pinned data/code/config/lock/artifacts; operation status projected

receipt.restore: Return first accepted receipt; same key new payload conflicts
receipt.reject: RESERVED receipt falsely COMMITTED, response loss treated as rejected command

operation.store: research operations; terminal immutable, attempts separate
operation.transaction: Job claim/cancel/publication UoW; no repository commit
operation.restore: Durable state/attempt/artifact closure; reclaim only via lease generation
operation.reject: Stale worker publish, terminal rewrite, cancellation after terminal success

attempt.transaction: Generation-fenced job UoW; final attempt immutable
attempt.restore: Resolve exact current attempt and checkpoint; no input mutation on retry
attempt.reject: Stale holder completion, duplicate attempt number different material

lease.transaction: DB-time claim/heartbeat CAS; stale process may still exist
lease.restore: Lease expiration permits reclaim only; validate generation on publication

artifact.store: Immutable content-addressed files + research publication index
artifact.transaction: Lease-fenced publication UoW after file verification
artifact.restore: Resolve exact published file/hash and run lineage
artifact.reject: Missing bytes, path traversal, arbitrary URL, unpublished download

simulation.store: Proposed session/control and genesis receipts; existing canonical account stores

simulation.restore: RECOVERING first; explicit validated resume; scenario/seed/clock/source closure
simulation.reject: Missing genesis, stale state/kill, auto RUNNING after restore

positions.store: Existing account head/checkpoint/expected snapshot/provider observations; target from Decision

positions.transaction: Read projection only; actual not copied from expected; canonical account writer sole economic authority
positions.restore: UNKNOWN retains reason; exact accepted revision/source; no position JSON PUT
positions.reject: Missing state inferred FLAT, copied expected presented as actual, historical READY reused

case.transaction: Accepted append/CAS semantics; legal resolve command never economic repair
case.restore: Resolve latest accepted case/run references; RESOLVED not trading permission

signal.reject: Duplicate key different material, absent prior state, mixed frontier/member

decision.reject: Incomplete cohort, opposite priority tie, decision reused after FLAT as entry permission

risk.transaction: Append input closure; permission separately revalidated at final submission

risk.reject: REJECT becomes FLAT, changed capital/constraints, stale ALLOW
